Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXV OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXV OF 1979
PEOPLE'S FINANCE CORPORATION
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An ordinance further to
amend the Peoples' Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th April 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The following Ordinance
made by the President on the 23rd April 1979, is hereby published for general
information:‑
1. Short title and
commencement. This
Ordinance may be called the People's Finance Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance,
1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of long title and preamble, Act XXIX of 1972

ORDINANCE XXV OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXV OF 1979
PEOPLE'S FINANCE CORPORATION
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An ordinance further to
amend the Peoples' Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th April 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The following Ordinance
made by the President on the 23rd April 1979, is hereby published for general
information:‑
2. Amendment of long title
and preamble, Act XXIX of 1972.‑In the Peoples' Finance Corporation Act, 1972 (XXIX of 1972),
hereinafter referred to as the Act, in the long title and preamble for the
words "peoples' Finance Corporation" the words "Small Business
Finance Corporation" shall be substituted.
